name: Ulnar Neuropathy at the Elbow / Cubital Tunnel Syndrome
definition: Compression or irritation of the ulnar nerve at or around the elbow causing sensory and, in more advanced disease, motor dysfunction.

typical: Numbness/tingling in little and ulnar ring finger
Intrinsic hand weakness in advanced cases

redFlags.item: Rapid progressive weakness or muscle wasting

investigations.principle: Electrodiagnostic testing is useful when severity, localization or surgical planning requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs when bony deformity/trauma is relevant.

amber: Surgery is considered for persistent severe symptoms, weakness or denervation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Peripheral Vata/neuropathy phenotype may be recorded in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Compression or irritation of the ulnar nerve at or around the elbow causing sensory and, in more advanced disease, motor dysfunction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Ulnar Nerve Entrapment at the Elbow
